UserSessionCookie.name: redsec_session
UserSessionCookie.description: Signed user session cookie created by POST /api/auth/login. Required for all authenticated API routes under /api (except public endpoints like survey response). The session encodes the user ID and is verified against server-side session storage. Sessions expire based on server configuration (default 24h, extended sessions up to 30 days with 'keep me signed in'). MFA-protected accounts require completing POST /api/auth/login/mfa before the session is promoted to fully authenticated.

GuestSessionCookie.name: redsec_guest
GuestSessionCookie.description: Signed guest cookie created by visiting /guest/{token}. Grants access only to paste creation (POST /api/paste) or share creation (POST /api/share), depending on the link scope. Guest sessions cannot access any other API routes.

ExtensionBearer.description: Bearer token returned by POST /api/ext/auth/login. Used by the Chrome extension API under /api/ext. Tokens expire based on server session TTL. Extension sessions have the same RBAC permissions as the linked user account but are separate from browser sessions.

AdminCookie.name: redsec_admin
AdminCookie.description: Signed admin session cookie created by POST /admin/login. Required for all routes under /admin/api. After initial bootstrap, admin API access also requires an active linked UserSessionCookie (redsec_session) — both cookies must be present. This two-step auth ensures admin actions are tied to a logged-in user session.

ServiceAccountBearer.description: Scoped service-account API token with rst_sa_ prefix. Tokens are shown once and stored hashed. In Swagger UI, Authorize adds this bearer token to proxied requests; use the cookie mode control to choose current browser cookies, no cookies, or Swagger Authorize-only requests for live RBAC testing.

ivPassword.description: Base64 12-byte IV used by the password re-encryption layer when hasPassword is true.

salt.description: Base64 16-byte PBKDF2 salt when hasPassword is true.

feedMetadata.description: Feed-type-specific config (auth, headers, field mapping for API feeds; proxy config for onion)

disabledByUser.description: True when a shared default keyword is disabled for the current user

iocs.description: Structured IOC summary derived from the stored alert content

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit or auth cooldown triggered

post.description: Analyzes pasted raw response headers or fetches headers from a public URL through the SSRF-safe fetch guard. post.summary: Analyze TLS certificate, DNS, CT, and cipher posture
post.description: Runs a server-side TLS certificate and recon check for a public target. Bare hosts default to port 443, host:port is supported, and targets are validated through the public-target guard before any outbound TLS or DNS consistency probes are made. Optional DNS, Certificate Transparency, and cipher checks provide the same categories of output as the standalone TLS recon tool: certificate attributes, SAN expansion, chain, negotiated TLS context, DNS security records, per-IP certificate consistency, findings, and export-ready structured data.

target.description: Public hostname, host:port, or http(s) URL.

includeDns.description: Resolve A/AAAA, NS, MX, CAA, SPF, DMARC, DNSSEC, wildcard DNS, AXFR probe, and per-IP cert consistency.

includeCt.description: Query crt.sh Certificate Transparency names for the host.

includeCiphers.description: Run slower TLS protocol/cipher probes using server runtime TLS capabilities.

403.description: Missing minitools.view permission or tool disabled

post.summary: Run a DNS Intelligence MiniTool lookup
post.description: Runs one of the local/free DNS Intelligence tools through a registry-driven server-side executor. Supports DNS records, security DNS report, DNSSEC, reverse DNS, mail DNS health, resolver consistency, HTTP headers, site availability, fixed-list light port checks, DNSBL checks, and URL decode. DNS lookups use selectable public recursive resolvers with Cloudflare as the default, not the host server's system DNS settings. The route enforces user auth, minitools.view, per-tool enablement, validation, per-tool rate limits, explicit timeouts, fixed port lists, and audit logging.

target.description: Domain, hostname, IP, URL, or encoded string depending on the selected tool.

recordType.description: DNS record type for DNS record and resolver consistency lookups.

resolverProfile.description: Public recursive resolver profile. Defaults to cloudflare.

dkimSelector.description: Optional DKIM selector for mail DNS health and security DNS report.

plusToSpace.description: URL Decode option to convert plus characters to spaces.

repeatDecode.description: URL Decode option to repeat decoding up to three passes.

403.description: Missing minitools.view permission or tool disabled

429.description: DNS Intelligence route or per-tool rate limit reached

post.description: Parses OpenAPI 3.x, Swagger 2.0, Postman Collection, or raw endpoint list input and returns a structured endpoint inventory with security risk tags. Supports JSON and YAML input via paste or file upload. All processing is local — no external requests are made. Rate limited to 15 requests per minute.

specFile.description: API spec file (JSON or YAML, max 5 MB)

spec.description: API spec content as text (JSON or YAML)

200.description: Analysis result with endpoints, risk tags, and overview

403.description: Missing minitools.view permission or tool disabled

429.description: API Analyzer rate limit reached (15 per minute)

post.description: Generates a downloadable export of API analysis results in CSV, Markdown, plain text, curl skeletons, or Burp request skeletons format. Rate limited to 15 requests per minute.

section.description: Content section for markdown/text exports (all, auth_summary, idor, tenant, mass_assignment, sensitive, unauthenticated)
